xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and HalfYear ended on September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 4, 2026. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have carried out their Limited Review Report on the Statement and have issued an unmodified opinion.

2. The Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad, vide its order dated 21 July 2026, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of 1. Vintage Coffee Private Limited (“Transferor Company”) 2. Delecto Foods Private Limited (“Transferor Company”) with Vintage Coffee and Beverages limited (“Transferee Company” or “the Company”) under sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, with the appointed date of 1 October 2025. The certified copy of the order was filed with the Registrar of Companies on 31 August 2026, being the effective date of the Scheme. As the Transferor and the Company are under common control, the amalgamation has been accounted for using the pooling of interest’s method in accordance with Appendix C of md AS 103 “Business Combinations”, as prescribed in the Scheme. Accordingly, the assets, liabilities and reserves of the Transferor have been recorded at their carrying values with effect from the appointed date, inter company balances and transactions have been eliminated, and the figures for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 and the year ended 31 March 2026 have been restated to include the Transferor from 1 October 2025. The figures for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2025 pertain to the period before the appointed date and have not been restated. Consequently, the figures for the current periods are not comparable with those for the quarter and six months ended 30 September 2025.

3.The Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026 have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measuremert of principals laid down in the md AS.

4. Segment reporting is not applicable to the Company as it operates in only one segment, i.e. Trading, Manufacturing and Export of Instant Coffee and Instant Chicory Products.
5. The figures for the previous quarter/year have been regrouped, re-casted and rearranged, wherever considered necessary.
6. The Results for the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30,2026 are also available on Bombay Stock Exchange website and National Stock Exchange website and on Company’s website.
